race.comment: Tough finish. CRUISERWEIGHT (17) had his chance last time but kept trying at Sandown Hillside with 60kg. He drops 5kg off that effort and while the gloss might have come off him, he sets up nicely here to track a good speed. SAVOYARD (19) caught they eye charging home first up over 1100m in big splits. Straight to 1400m off a month between runs is a query and he'll get back again but he's got plenty of talent. PORTER (7) stuck on well fresh in a fast run race behind Home Rule, he'll roll forward and prove hard to run down. STYLISH (2) is quite reliable and didn't miss by much last start. Go well again.
